Title: Paris, France: Sabbat release tournament, Feb. 16th

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
For those who'd like to travel to Paris on February, 16th, I'd like to organize a release tournament that day.
(in French) www.vekn.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?f=27&t=18964

In short, there's 16 slots. Each player has a random Sabbat starter and competes on 4 players tables against the other starters.
The final is played by the best player for each of the 4 starters.

To balance the tournament, there is an additional rule:

Before each round, the players of the "weakest" clan will vote to choose the seating after the other clans have been seated randomly. If there is no majority, its position is determined randomly.

The weakest clan is the one with the fewest victory points made on the previous rounds by the players of that clan.

If there is a tie, the following order is used (from the weakest to the stronger):
